description_expanded: Sun Sand Repeat - Modern Coastal Townhome in Gulf Place About Sun Sand Repeat: Welcome to your perfect 30A beach getaway at Sun Sand Repeat in Santa Rosa Beach, located in the charming Gulf Place Courtyard community along Scenic Highway 30A. This spacious multi-level townhome offers the ideal blend of coastal comfort, walkable convenience, and easy access to the emerald waters of the Gulf of Mexico. The home comfortably accommodates families and groups with three spacious bedrooms and multiple bathrooms, offering privacy and comfort for every guest. The primary suite provides a quiet retreat with its own private outdoor space, while additional guest rooms make hosting friends and family easy. Located in the highly sought-after Gulf Place community, guests enjoy access to resort-style amenities including a community pool, tennis courts, pickleball, and deeded beach access. The pedestrian-friendly setting places you just steps from local boutiques, restaurants, cafés, and seasonal live music at nearby Gulf Place Town Center. Explore the 30A bike and walking path, spend your days relaxing on the sugar-white sand beaches, or enjoy sunset dining at one of the many nearby coastal restaurants. Whether you're planning a family vacation, couples’ retreat, or extended beach stay, this Santa Rosa Beach vacation rental offers the perfect base for experiencing the laid-back charm of Florida’s Emerald Coast.
